plainTranslation: The Moon person's needs and the Sun person's way of being can rub in a place both people feel quickly. One person's normal self-expression may land as emotional disruption to the other. This can work, but only when both people stop treating their own rhythm as the only reasonable one.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
